incoming.name: Fungus
incoming.excerpt: The first land fungi probably appeared in the Silurian, right after the first land plants appeared, even though their fossils are fragmentary.

incoming.name: Plant
incoming.excerpt: Vascular plants first appeared during the Silurian period, and by the Devonian had diversified and spread into many different land environments.
